notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 31-33) does not contain the General Studies: Arts and Humanities A.A. section. It prints only the LACCD General Education Pattern, the LAPC Cal-GETC certification pattern and the start of the C-ID table, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers could be recorded.

The section_heading names the closest relevant heading in the text (the LACCD GE pattern). That pattern's Area 3: Arts and Humanities list contains most closed-list courses, but it is a GE area and not this award's major requirements. Courses from GE lists were therefore not placed in blocks.

The LACCD GE pattern states 'Major Requirements: Minimum of 18 units in a single or related field' and 'General Education Requirements: Minimum of 27 semester units'. These are general rules for degrees, not this award's printed totals, so total_units, degree_total and ge_units stay null.
A reviewer should locate the program's own page (likely later in the catalog's program section) to record its requirements.
